Bilgisayarlar sayfasından bir bilgisayar: Open a computer from the Computers page.
Remote screen is off on this computer.
Remote command is off on this computer.
Kullanıcının ekranı kilitli; ağ yalnızca: The user's screen is locked and the network only reaches the POps server. Lifting it returns the computer to normal. If the computer cannot reach the server, generate an offline unlock code and give it to the user (tray icon → "Yönetici Müdahalesi (Bypass)").
Ağ yalıtımı uygulanamadı: Network isolation could not be applied
Ekran kilitli ama güvenlik duvarı kurall: The screen is locked, but the firewall rules could not be applied, so the computer can still reach the network.
Bunlar ajanın arka plan işlerindeki hata: These are errors in the agent's background work: connecting to the server, syncing policy, sending inventory. The agent keeps running; the counter resets after an hour without new errors. Details are in the agent log on the computer:
Güncel sürüm {latest}. Eski ajanda sınav: The current version is {latest}. New features such as exam mode, file transfer, power actions and messages may not work on an old agent.
Tepsi uygulaması kullanıcının oturumunda: The tray app runs in the user's session, so it is not connected when nobody is signed in. Messages, screen consent and locking go through the tray.
Kapalı özellik bilgisayarın kendisinde k: A feature that is off was turned off on the computer itself (at install or with a local setting); the panel cannot turn it on. That way it stays off on that computer even if the server is compromised.
Ajan donanım envanterini ilk bağlantıda: The agent sends its hardware inventory on its first connection.
Kurulu programlar 0.1.5 ve sonraki ajanl: Installed programs come from agents 0.1.5 and later.
\"Güncellemeleri tara\" ile bilgisayarda: Use "Scan for updates" to ask the computer for its Windows Update status.
Tarama isteği gönderildi; sonuç birkaç d: Scan requested; the result arrives within a few minutes.
Ajan bilgisayarı yeniden başlatmaz; gere: The agent does not restart the computer; if needed it reports "restart required".
Bu bilgisayarda henüz işlem yok: No operations on this computer yet
Gönderilen komutlar, güç işlemleri, dağı: Commands, power actions, deployments and remote screen sessions show up here.
Oturum açma, yasaklı site, karantina ve: Sign-ins, blocked sites, quarantine and agent events show up here.
Bilgisayara gönderilen ve bilgisayardan: Files sent to and fetched from the computer show up here.
